about.question: Did someone tell you that your knowledge cannot be implemented in real-world problems?
about.body: At MUICT Dev Club, we believe that knowledge can be applied to real-world problems. We are a sandbox for everyone to learn, try ideas, and experience working in software development. Alongside developers, we welcome other important roles such as Quality Assurance, UX/UI Design, and Art. We cannot wait to see you here.

cards.title: ACADEMIC GROWTH
cards.description: MUICT Dev Club often explores topics and technologies that may not be covered in your regular coursework. This can broaden your knowledge and give you a more well-rounded education.

cards.title: EXPANDED COMMUNITY
cards.description: Working with peers in MUICT Dev Club setting can improve your teamwork and communication skills. Collaboration is an essential skill in both academia and the professional world.

cards.title: ENHANCED EXPERIENCE
cards.description: Being part of MUICT Dev Club often involves working on real projects and practical coding tasks. This hands-on experience can deepen your understanding of programming languages and concepts.

items.question: What is this club?
items.answer: MUICT Dev Club is a sandbox for everyone to learn, try ideas, and experience working in software development. Alongside developers, we welcome Quality Assurance, UX/UI Design, Art, and Marketing roles.

items.question: How can I join MUICT Dev Club?
items.answer: Click Joining information in the navigation bar or hero section to check our current recruitment status and submit your application form when applications are open.

items.question: Do I need prior coding experience to apply?
items.answer: No prior industry experience is required! First-year ICT and DST students are warmly welcome. Our workshops and project squads pair newcomers with senior mentors.

items.question: What kind of events and projects does the club run?
items.answer: We host hands-on tech workshops, UI/UX design clinics, mini hackathons, cross-team software sprints, and Demo Days throughout the Mahidol academic year.
